sar.narrative: This report details suspected card-not-present fraud involving customer C13284 and card C13284-K1. On 2016-12-29 at 15:47:08, an online transaction of $74.98 was attempted in billing region 204 using an anonymous.com email address. Although the transaction amount was typical for the cardholder, the purchase involved product code H, which the customer had never used before. The bank's real-time risk score flagged the activity at 0.85, and the transaction model scored it at 0.827. The primary indicator of fraud is the use of a rare, fully specified device profile, FRD-L09 Build/HUAWEIFRD-L09 with Android 7.0 and Chrome 66.0. Graph evidence shows this exact device was used on 4 other cards belonging to 7 other customers between 2016-12-22 and 2016-12-29, which is strong evidence of a fraud ring. The transaction model also scored 5 of those connected other-card uses as fraud. The total exposure for this incident is $74.98.
